title: Exclusive: Nvidia and ChipAgents Launch Evaluation For AI-Powered Chip Design
text:
Nvidia and ChipAgents, a startup that helps customers automate chip design, on Wednesday released a benchmark that measures how different AI models perform at the task.
Anthropic’s Fable 5.1 powered the best-performing AI agent in the newly released evaluation but only scored 16.6% on the test, ...
